title: Black Belt's Training (Poke Ball) 097/131 Sv: Prismatic Evolutions Reverse Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon TCG card from the Prismatic Evolutions set, featuring Black Belt's Training illustrated by Gossan. This common card has a reverse holo finish and is part of the English-language collection by The Pokémon Company. With a card number of 097/131, this trainer card is a valuable addition for collectors and players alike in the world of Pokémon card games.
